item.title: Dazaifu Tenmangu: Shrine of Learning — Guide
item.description: Dazaifu Tenmangu, just outside Fukuoka city, is one of the most revered shrines in Japan, dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane, the Heian-era scholar-official deified as Tenjin, the god of learning. Students from across the country come to pray for success in exams, and the beautiful grounds are famous for their plum trees — Michizane’s favourite — which bloom in late winter, including a legendary ‘flying plum’ said to have flown from Kyoto to be near him.
